title: Can the existing fans and flue be reused when adding natural gas to an oil-fired bogie-hearth furnace?
summary: Reusing fans and flues still requires checking their interfaces with the new combustion system. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s 20 m bogie-hearth furnace retrofit proposal dated 13 November 2018 retains oil heating and adds natural-gas combustion. Both can operate independently while sharing the original exhaust and combustion-air systems. New air branches and changeover valves close the original oil-burner air branches during gas operation. Reuse therefore includes changeover design and verification, not simply leaving old equipment untouched.
